text: Ironvale Athletic starts a counter-attack near their own penalty area on the left side. Jonah Lindqvist carries the ball forward along the left flank and then makes a short pass to Ilias Thorne, who is positioned centrally about 7 metres from the goal at the far end. Thorne controls the ball and quickly shoots with his foot, scoring to equalize the match at 3-3 with only minutes left to play [#1532] [#1533] [#1534] [#1537].
